metrics.amends: baselines_sota (read p1_bindings tag sota: ours 372 vs STRAP 168, DSRL 234, experience replay 138)
metrics.dsrl_differences: authors' pi0.5 LIBERO config (github.com/gonora24/dsrl_pi0 run_libero_pi05.sh, train_utils_sim.py, jaxrl2 pixel_sac): a 7-dim latent tiled over the chunk in action dims 0-6 (ours: all 320 dims), bound 1.0 (ours 2.0), 10 critics with min reduction (ours 2), no entropy backup, auto temperature from 1.0, 20 updates per transition (ours 4), discount 0.999 (ours 0.99), hidden 128; ours added a sigmoid critic and per-dimension entropy to survive 320 dims
metrics.hypotheses: B1' ours vs strap2, B2' ours vs dsrlo, B3 ours vs er (unchanged), Holm over the three; the earlier strap and dsrl arms are reported as our variants (descriptive)

new_arms.dsrlo: DSRL with the authors' configuration (kept from ours: frozen ResNet-18 features + state instead of their 64 x 64 CNN; the one-demo LoRA as the base policy, since pi0.5 alone succeeds ~0 on these tasks; 100 practice episodes on states 0-29)
new_arms.strap2: STRAP with the authors' retrieval rules (kept from ours: a LoRA on pi0.5 instead of a policy trained from scratch; one target demo instead of five; frames capped at 3,000)

metrics.strap_differences: authors' retrieval (github.com/WEIRDLabUW/STRAP retrieval_utils.py, retrieval.py): segmentation = cut after every step with L1 end-effector displacement < 2.5 mm, merge pieces < 20 steps (ours: speed below its 20th percentile); S-DTW steps (1,1) and (1,2) only (ours also allowed stalls); top_k / n_segments per segment with no global trim (ours trimmed to K overall)
metrics.why: a check of the authors' code after the read (user request: account for the existing solutions' implementations) found our DSRL and STRAP differ from them in ways that may matter
metrics.written_before: any rollout of dsrlo or strap2
